headline: Can We Leave This SaaS Tool? 6 Exit Checks Before Renewal
description: A practical educational checklist for small-business owners testing data portability, ownership, restore evidence, and exit sequencing before a SaaS renewal decision.
claimBoundary: Educational vendor-exit planning material only — not legal, compliance, privacy, security, procurement, accounting, contract, or production migration advice. No client results, certifications, rankings, savings, or guarantees are claimed.

exitChecks.name: Data Inventory
exitChecks.text: What records, files, settings, and history does the team rely on?

exitChecks.name: Export Format
exitChecks.text: Can required information be exported in documented, reusable formats?

exitChecks.name: Relationships
exitChecks.text: Do exports preserve links between customers, messages, invoices, tasks, and attachments?

exitChecks.name: Ownership
exitChecks.text: Who is authorized to export, verify, retain, and approve deletion?

exitChecks.name: Restore Test
exitChecks.text: Can a sample export be opened, counted, and reconstructed in a safe test location?

exitChecks.name: Exit Sequence
exitChecks.text: Are access removal, retention, integrations, billing, and final verification ordered and assigned?
